The '''Wenderal system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a number of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cells were active in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] learned from contacts in the Wenderal system cells about the company [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] having covered up the fact that several lots of its [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] model&mdash;with a number of shipments of the [[Supervisor droid/Legends|droids]] having already gone out&mdash;had been erroneously fitted with<ref name="AIR" /> illegal<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[MDF motivator]]s<ref name="AIR" /> designed for use in [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wenderal system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square R-3.<ref name="TEA" />
